generationRule: A blueprint constrains shape and intended decision; it does not assign a certified solution. Instantiate only through core model/geometry and replay every resulting variant through the core engine.

families.motif: two or more separated color groups joined only by sparse roof anchors
families.decision: remove an anchor to drop a remote island
families.avoid: same anchor cell and same target color partition across neighboring levels

families.motif: shallow symmetric arch with a deliberately open center lane
families.avoid: mirror-only variation; symmetry is not a distinct base level

families.motif: asymmetric stepped groups with changing row parity
families.decision: choose a reachable step and plan the resulting group

families.motif: a bridge held by two independent supports
families.decision: remove one support now or create access to both
families.avoid: bridges that collapse identically for every first shot

families.motif: two dense banks with a clear central shooting corridor
families.decision: preserve a straight route while clearing one bank
families.avoid: corridor whose only meaningful action is always the same color

families.motif: one or two recessed side pockets behind a visible lip
families.decision: use a wall bounce or open the pocket entrance
families.avoid: pocket requiring an angular window below the difficulty floor

families.motif: a narrow lateral bridge linking unequal masses
families.decision: break the bridge at a selected side
families.avoid: equal mirror halves with interchangeable outcomes

families.motif: fan-shaped groups spreading from a compact upper support
families.decision: select a branch whose removal creates the largest useful fall
families.avoid: radial recolors retaining identical group and objective semantics

families.motif: offset central spine with alternating side branches
families.decision: clear a branch without closing the next route
families.avoid: single-file chains that make aim and choice trivial

families.motif: staggered columns with distinct gaps and support heights
families.decision: choose which column to destabilize first
families.avoid: periodic repetition of one identical column module

families.motif: one or more stars held inside a roof-connected central enclosure
families.decision: remove a specific support to release the central target
families.avoid: star already adjacent to an inevitable one-shot group

families.motif: star-bearing side mass reachable by a deliberate bank or bridge removal
families.decision: select the side and support whose fall frees the target
families.avoid: unreadable hidden access or an arbitrarily narrow bank angle

openingSliceLearningSequence.intent: one clear direct shot teaches aim and a valid match
show that all same-color cells in the connected group resolve together
make target choice visible while another color remains present
remove a support and observe a disconnected mass fall
make current/next choice materially useful; swap costs no shot
teach a broad, readable left-wall route
teach the opposite route with a different shape and decision
present two supports with meaningfully different removal outcomes
require a useful setup shot before the finishing shot
combine established aim, swap and support concepts without introducing a new rule

orbitIntroductions.mechanic: direct aim, match, swap, falls and first wall banks
rocks as non-matching supports and side routes
rescue stars by disconnecting them from the roof
clear selected colors while ignoring distractors
